candidates.headline: Cowboys RB Malik Davis set for hip surgery, headed to IR
candidates.description: Dallas Cowboys running back Malik Davis is scheduled to have surgery Saturday and be placed on injured reserve after suffering a hip injury in Friday's practice, a source told ESPN Friday.

candidates.headline: Sources: Bears, RB Swift agree to 3-year, $33.75M extension
candidates.description: The Bears and running back D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a three-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

candidates.headline: Texans rookie Kayden McDonald placed on IR with ankle injury
candidates.description: Texans rookie defensive tackle Kayden McDonald (ankle) was placed on injured reserve, meaning he'll have to wait four weeks to make his debut.
